title: ChemInform Abstract: Reaction of an Enolizable Diazo‐Compound with the Electron‐Rich Stannylene Sn(N(SiMe3)2)2: Preparation of a Novel Spiro(1,3,4,2‐oxadiazastannine‐6,4′‐pyrazole) Derivative.
abstract: AbstractThe 2:1 molar reaction of the enolizable diazo compound (II) with the electron‐rich stannylene (I) yields the 2:1 adduct (III) additional to the hydrazone NH2N=C(COMe)(COOEt) (yield 12%).
